title: Russian-Style Broccoli Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with steamed broccoli, tender beef, and creamy Russian dressing.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Russian dressing and black pepper.
Warm the tortilla wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the Russian dressing on the tortilla, followed by the beef and broccoli mixture.
Top with additional onion and garlic if desired.
